Definition: Region samples originated from: CB = Chesapeake Bay
Sample identifier used in laboratory and field
Site code identifier for sampling transect location (GCW, SWH, MSM, GWI), see dataset locations for coordinates
Plot within space-for-time transect (UP=Upland, SWAMP=Swamp, TR=Transition, WC=Wetland Center)

Soil gas well replicate (A, B, C), atmosphere sample identifier (ATM, collected from ambient air in the given plot), or for samples collected at GCW-UP (also TEMPEST Control) the Letter+Number identifying the grid square within the Plot (see dataset description).
Depth in centimeters below soil surface from which gas sample was taken
Machine on which gas sample was analyzed
